about: What importing os_optics.local.json_api loads besides the standard library and os_optics itself. A headless JSON host imports this module at startup, so every package listed here is paid for before it can compute. Checked by tests/test_import_closure.py in a fresh interpreter. Names starting with an underscore are not listed: they are private implementation modules of the packages below and vary between their releases and builds (scipy 1.18 adds scipy._external; Cython registers versioned helper modules). To add an entry, give the reason the module must load at import time; a package or subpackage that only some methods need is imported inside those functions instead.

third_party_packages.numpy: array arithmetic used at module level throughout os_optics
third_party_packages.pydantic: request, response and model schemas are pydantic models defined at import time
